event_description: User opens an activity detail view from browse, map, or direct link.
User shares an activity via native share or clipboard copy.
User clicks the 'Visit official page' link on an activity detail.
User adds an activity to their calendar.
User submits a new activity suggestion via the share form.
User reports that an activity's info is outdated or incorrect.
User signs up for expansion watch notifications for a new city.
User selects a city filter when browsing activities.
Home seasonal banner (e.g. Hello Fall) becomes visible to the user.
User clicks See all on the home seasonal banner to open the collection.
User opens an activity from the home seasonal banner carousel.
